comparison.objective: Place three color-coded ECG lead clips at the correct manikin electrode locations.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulate deformable leads, reason about mirrored body locations, and place/release clips.
comparison.success_condition: Each clip lies in its assigned cup, no clip is wrong, fixtures remain fixed, leads stay attached, and all clips rest released for 1 second.
comparison.reason: Cable handling and semantic placement are meaningfully different from mandrel alignment, hammer impact, notch fracture, and containment of four free tangs.
